🏊‍♀️ Meet Kashvi Suresh of Class VI B, a young swimmer enjoying an extraordinary 2026 season.

At just 11 years old, Kashvi competed in the U14 Girls category and brought home an incredible 112 medals: 48 gold, 37 silver and 27 bronze, along with four individual championship trophies. 🥇

Her journey this year has taken her from the State level to the CISCE Zonal and Regional levels, culminating in the CISCE Nationals, where she competed in the 100m Butterfly, 200m Individual Medley and 4×100m IM Relay.

Her performances at the CISCE Nationals have now earned her selection for the SGFI.

Beyond the medals, Kashvi’s story is one of discipline, technique, mental strength and the dedication it takes to balance rigorous training with academics, all while representing Vidyashilp School Bagalur with pride.

We’re incredibly proud of Kashvi and look forward to cheering her on in the next chapter of her journey! 🎉

A day of learning, creativity and expression at Vidyashilp School, Bagalur. ✨

Vidya Utsav brought together our students from Grades 7–10 through a vibrant showcase of performances, storytelling and drama.

From the thought-provoking Nukkad Natak and literary adaptations like Homecoming and The Monkey’s Paw, to Boston Tea Party, Skimbleshanks and the Kannada drama Parivartane, each presentation reflected the students’ creativity, confidence and understanding.

The foyer added another dimension to the experience, with student exhibits, projects and presentations showcasing learning beyond the classroom.

A celebration of curiosity, creativity and learning — brought to life by our young performers. 🌟
